EmailTemplate.subject: See you in San Diego!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
See you in San Diego! The Flywire team is excited to connect at Epic CORE San Diego. Let’s close out the first night in style!
Join Flywire, Revecore, Cedar, Clearbalance, and Kodiak Solutions for curated cocktails, delicious appetizers, and hourly giveaways—all with stunning views of San Diego Bay. ‌
When: Wednesday, February 19 | 5:30 PM - 9:30 PM PST ‌
Where: Coasterra 880 Harbor Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92101 Complimentary transportation available at the Sheraton San Diego, with pick-up and drop-off at the front portico.
We'll meet you there!
